nom: Naturium Barrier Bounce Advanced Skin Hydrator

segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the serum sits on top of skin, feels heavy or sweaty, and causes clogging or greasiness, though a few say a very small amount works without excess shine.
segments.dry: The great majority of reviewers describing dry, very dry, or dehydrated skin report strong, lasting hydration, reduced flakiness and tightness, and a glowy, plumped look, with several calling it a holy grail for dry climates or winter.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: some (including combo-oily) say it clogs or sits heavy, while others (combo-dry, combo-sensitive) say it fixed a compromised barrier and gave a hydrated glow.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided, with several reporting redness, itching, burning, or small bumps/allergic reaction, while others with sensitive or reactive/eczema-prone skin report no breakouts and improved barrier and calmness.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s to 70+) consistently report a youthful glow, plumping, and it being a game-changer moisturizer for age-related dryness.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report plumping of fine lines, a youthful glow, and it becoming a staple for menopausal or aging skin changes; no negative aging-specific reports appear.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers describe fixing severe dryness, tightness, and flakiness (including post-retinoid, post-chemo, and harsh-climate skin), with consistently positive outcomes reported for this concern.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report the product reduced redness and irritation from cold weather or retinoid use, but others report the product itself caused new redness, burning, or itching, suggesting inconsistent tolerance.
concerns.barrier: Many reviewers credit the product with repairing a compromised or weakened barrier, citing relief from retinoid irritation, perioral dermatitis, and winter dryness; no reviewer reports it worsening barrier function.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with hormonal acne reports the product helped reduce breakouts; this is not corroborated elsewhere and sits in tension with the many breakout complaints under 'blemishes'.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report the product caused new breakouts, cystic-feeling bumps, or clogging, sometimes after just one use, while a smaller number of acne-prone or breakout-prone reviewers report no new breakouts or even fewer breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the product feels greasy, sits on the skin, and does not suit an oily complexion, though one oily-skin reviewer says a very small amount gives glow without excess shine.

aspects.libelle: Greasy, heavy feel that resists absorbing
Separation of formula, needs vigorous shaking
Wears well under makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: shame on me for not thoroughly reading the ingredients of this product. I was interested to try this because I love hydrating products, especially skin barrier improving products. I am quite sensitive to a chemical exfoliants, particularly if they are in a serum that is left on my skin. Long story short, this product has lactic acid in it. Correct me if I'm wrong, but exfoliants of any kind can damage your skin barrier if it is compromised. I would never use a moisturizing serum with a chemical exfoliant when my skin is dehydrated, and I need to focus on hydrating and soothing it. not for me! would not recommend if you have sensitive skin, dehydrated, skin, etc.

Bought this a couple days ago and used as directed. Immediately broke out in red, itchy bumps that haven't gone away. Product is greasy and doesn't look at all like what's pictured here. My skin is not sensitive and hasn't broken out in YEARS. Not sure what happened with this product but I'm so frustrated and worried about my skin now

extraits.titre: Not great for combo/oily skin type
extraits.texte: I bought this a few months ago and have found it to not suit my combo/oily skin type. The product just seems to sit on top of my skin rather than absorb, as well as make me feel sweaty and sticky. I think it has also caused some clogging due to this. If you have drier skin and are looking to be glowy, this is a wonderful product, however for my oily gals it may not be your fav.

This is so moisturizing and nourishing. I only wish I found it sooner so I could have used it all winter. I have combination sensitive skin, breakout prone. I think its important to note that what people think is a "greasy" or "oily" feeling is actually the urea acting as a powerful humectant, pulling moisture from the air to put into the skin. It tends to have a sticky residue, that means it's working. However, it absorbs well and I have no problem putting a full face of makeup ontop. My skin is noticeably smoother and has mitigated the redness and irritation from the below zero temps. This has become a new staple in my routine. I can't believe its less than $20. This isnt a sponsored review, I really love this sh*t.

extraits.titre: Dry and mature skin's best friend
extraits.texte: This product does exactly what it says it does. It is hydrating and plumps and nourishes the skin while leaving a youthful looking glow. It lays well beneath makeup and is a Holy Grail product for me. But, i don't believe it is for everyone. I give it 5 stars for my dry, mature skin type. Like some of the negative reviews note, it might be too much for those with oily skin. Also, if you don't have a consistent skin regime, this product may not absorb well due to exfoliation needs. Products can only work as well as you work with them and they won't work for every skin type. This formulation is pretty specific for those leaning dry, in my opinion.

This stuff is amazing. I have been struggling with menopausal skin, and after the first night I am hooked. I am dry, sensitive to fragrance, and prone to breakouts. Nothing worked like this, it feels luxurious going on, and shows the magic in the morning. Soft, smooth, hydrated skin!

I have very dry, sensitive eczema and acne prone skin. It's very reactive so it can be hard to find products that don't trigger one or the other. This has been great for my texture and healing my skin barrier without causing acne breakouts. The texture is interesting - it's very runny at first but then as you blend it in it kind of sets down and takes a little more work to really rub in. But with very dry skin, I appreciate how occlusive it feels because it feels like it seals all the moisture into my skin. I also think even if you don't have dry skin like me, this is a great option for a moisturizer because it's not thick at all. I'm still undecided on if I'd repurchase but I think the product itself is amazing.
